description: Patch/minor and major updates merge themselves once CI is green (majors in their own PRs).

pip-compile.description: requirements.txt is a lock file compiled from pyproject.toml by `uv pip compile` (see its header). Renovate bumps pyproject.toml and re-runs that command, so pins and hashes stay consistent.

pip_requirements.description: requirements.txt is compiled, never edited as plain requirements (that breaks the hashes); the pip-compile manager owns it.

pep621.description: pip-compile reads pyproject.toml itself as the source of requirements.txt; pep621 alone would bump pyproject.toml without recompiling requirements.txt.

packageRules.description: Patch and minor updates merge by themselves once CI is green
Major updates in their own PRs, merged by themselves once CI is green
